Draft: the TransBERT-bio-fr logo, round 2, three variants

The mascot of the talk's model, in the look of the CamemBERT and DrBERT logos so that the three read as one family: DrBERT's yellow face, black contours, red nose, white eyes with black pupils and catch-lights, open mouth with its tongue (every tone sampled from its PNG). A long egg-shaped head and one bold brow nod to the BERT family's Bert, evoked and never reproduced. The camembert is a whole round with a wedge cut out; the translation is the translate sign of translation apps, EN turning into FR. Drawn entirely by transbert_logo.py and mascot.py; the wordmark beside it is a label, in Georgia. The CamemBERT and DrBERT logos are the files on disk, shown here only to compare.

1 · the camembert cap

The mascot wears a whole camembert as its cap: white bloomy rind, mottled, a wedge cut out at the front showing the pale-yellow cream of its two cut faces, a red cross on its side. It holds the translate sign where DrBERT holds its syringe: the English card, EN in the house's English blue, turning by a bold arrow into the French card, FR in the translated lilac.

TransBERT-bio-fr

2 · the head mirror and the box

A doctor's head mirror on the clinic's teal band; in front of the mascot a cut camembert in its poplar box, a teal label band round the box with a red-cross sticker; the translate sign at the top right.

TransBERT-bio-fr

At whole size, 1/3 and 1/20:

3 · the nurse's cap and the cheese pick

A nurse's cap with its red cross, as DrBERT wears; beside the mascot a cut camembert in its box, and the translate sign stuck in the cheese as a cheese pick's flag.

Round 1, rejected (23 October 2026)

The author: «I don't like the transBERT-bio-fr: I want it to be in the same shade as DrBERT, same colors, the style is pretty different ... The concept of translation (two bubbles) looks like a chat ... none of those are looking like a camembert.» Drawn by transbert_logo_round1.py in style B.
